source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
When the bearer is **destroyed** for the first time, roll a D6 as that phase ends. Only a **DEATH COMPANY** model may take it.

On a 2+, it returns to the battlefield with 3 wounds left, placed as near as it can be to the spot where it fell and outside **Engagement Range** of every enemy unit.

onSuccess.setBackUp: as close as possible to where it was destroyed

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the The Lost Brethren Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
